subject: Life Skills

source.subtopic: Spring: the weather in spring and how nature, animals and people are affected (what we eat, wear and do)

show.line: It is spring! The days get warmer. Flowers bloom and trees grow new leaves.

rounds.prompt: In spring, what do trees grow?
It is warm in spring. What can we wear?
What grows in the garden in spring?

hints: Think warm days and new flowers.
In spring many baby animals are born.

beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: I will wear my thick winter jacket!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Spring is warm. A T-shirt is better.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Spring days get warm. We wear lighter clothes!

parent_line: Can describe spring weather and how plants, animals and people change.
